pending_source_disposition: No campaign opens. Original 2024 has 178 placements but only 30 independently demonstrated later-M15 survivors, below the prospective 32-order requirement; 2025 has 22. Do not shorten the checkpoint or assume missing orders survived, widen the population, or substitute a nearby ledger. No economic judgment was made.

programs.1_entry_signal_market_structure: Select source feasibility of conditional variance standardization inside the original V7 signal laws. Cross, Return and Passive use an explicitly estimated standard deviation to normalize an original signed return. A forecast made before that return window can replace only the scale used by entry evaluation while retaining the original numerator, direction, clock and literal threshold. This is a measurement model for original signals, not another independent entry event or a prediction of trade profit.
programs.2_external_market_event: Unavailable by user instruction; no external economic source or FRBSF.
programs.3_order_time_session: Price-offset and market-wait families remain closed. Pending-maintenance feasibility is now unready and not widened. Preserve original execution and order expiry.
programs.4_position_management_exit: All closed exit, ratchet and child-position neighborhoods stay closed. Existing Passive management and every original hold/ARC/SL rule must use their original features and remain unchanged.
programs.5_portfolio_capital_risk: All original sizing and risk contracts remain exact. No lower capital unit, reserve or learned weight rescue. Any growth improvement must arise from full native results of the original V7 portfolio.
programs.7_diagnostics_causal_meta: No causal-admission treatment labels, propensity, counterfactual account rewards, prior fitted model or closed learner state. A variance target is observable on every market bar regardless of actual trades. Supporting fit/report work belongs only to Program 1.

structural_scope_before_prices.Cross: Original US100 minus half US30 and US500 one-H1 log return, rolling 120-return sample SD, threshold abs(z)>=0.5.
structural_scope_before_prices.Return: Original US30 four-H1 log return, rolling 120-return sample SD times sqrt(4), threshold z<=-0.5.
structural_scope_before_prices.Passive: Original US100 twelve-M15 log return, rolling 96-return sample SD times sqrt(12), threshold abs(z)>=1. Original state-based position management keeps its exact original scale.
structural_scope_before_prices.unchanged_types: Pressure and RC16/RC4 normalize ranges rather than return variance; their source formulas are outside this mathematically defined interface. This scope is selected from source algebra, not component profitability.
structural_scope_before_prices.difference: A time-varying ex-ante variance forecast replaces a backward-looking scale in an existing signal. It can change which scheduled original signals cross their unchanged thresholds, but cannot create a new symbol, direction law, wall-clock event, sizing rule or execution route. The frozen whole role bundle still requires full adjacent native economics.
